title: Group Chat and Locker
author: Sable Marchetti
blurb: Rafael Iversen, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
